U51 (DP83867IRRGZ), TP30, and TP100 from SK-AM62 PROC114E3_BRD.PcbDoc and schematic sheet 22. Extracted from the demo’s altium-to-circuit-json@0.0.114 output. Component, pad, port, and route coordinates are unchanged; the board outline is cropped around these parts.

Pins 13 and 48 both use the label VDDA1P8, but connect to separate test-point nets N20329347 and N17105648. Neither an embedded nor a standalone internal connection joins them in the reference. The PCB comparison highlights the network connected to pin 13; pin 48 and its test point must remain dimmed.

Reference: https://www.ti.com/tool/SK-AM62
